capture_overlap.timing_scope: Host receipt times of the sampler's start and completed progress lines

limitations: Release symbols omit inlined or unresolved frames.
All-thread totals include idle threads; commit context is narrower.
fcntl call flags are unavailable, so that label does not prove an fsync.
The profiler interval differs from the whole fixed workload CPU interval.
method: First matching context per branch; descendant matches are excluded. Terminal residuals conserve each scope weight. Weights are wall-stack residency units, not CPU percentages or absolute call counts.
